description:
The Zeigarnik Effect — explained in 60 seconds.

Your brain keeps unfinished tasks open like 40 browser tabs — on purpose.

What actually happens in your brain: Open loops create cognitive tension. That's why cliffhangers work and why you can't relax with a messy to-do list.

Try it today: Can't focus? Write the unfinished task on paper. The loop closes. Your RAM frees up.
